time.source: Paper Table II and the M1 instruction. Landing hover is a synthetic M1 contract, not the M0 20 s figure.

motion.wind_source: Synthetic calm for the first stationary segment. A later experiment owns wind-estimation error. The nominal regressor still uses airspeed, which equals ground speed at this wind.
motion.start_state: landed at the registered pad; wait draws no propulsion, so it does not identify theta

geometry.note: Low-value buoys are off the eastbound path to each UAV's high-value buoy. Both high-value buoys are far from both pads, so one UAV cannot collect the other UAV's high-value buoy cheaply.

belief.quadrature: Per UAV, 7 equal-width nodes on the support, weighted by the kernel and normalized. Coordinate-wise lookahead uses this marginal grid, not a 49-point tensor product.
belief.source: Support matches Table II. Kernel std, noise and the nominal point mass are synthetic M1 contracts. Kernel mean is not the truncated mean.

utility.formula: J = on_time_bits / b_ref - lambda_e * sum_m energy_used_j / e_ref
utility.source: Same shape as paper equation (7). Scales are synthetic and were fixed before the trial so a full high-value buoy is worth 5 utility points and 1 Wh costs 0.01.

energy.bulk_source: Synthetic short-range data-product radio. It is not an old service radius and it is not the LoRa command channel. Propulsion uses the existing Zeng nominal model; theta scales only P_nom. Auxiliary loads are not multiplied by theta.
energy.battery_rule: Sensitive initial energy equals the simulated cost of one calibration at theta=1 plus the high-value round trip at the posterior 0.95 quantile after a noise-free calibration, plus reserve and margin. Insensitive initial energy equals a calibration and high-value round trip at the support upper endpoint 1.4, plus reserve and margin. Probes use a large sentinel battery and are not trial samples.

radio.reuse: LoRa airtime, current and the M0A k=4/3 horizon. Commands, acks and telemetry are LoRa. The bulk product is not credited on LoRa.

lookahead.terminal: Analytic completion from the copied physical state and the updated belief. gamma=1. Not an exact Bayes optimum.

fixed_calibration: Both UAVs calibrate on decision epoch 0 only, then use the passive rule.

diagnostics.fixed_receiver: One row per scenario. Receivers stay at the two UAV pads and use the same bulk-range contract.
diagnostics.direct: Same bulk contract from buoy to shore. Accounted beside the trial and not counted as an environment mission.
